**Plan context (pinned):** [plan](../../../plans/2026-10-02-001-feat-internal-mode-plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts.md) · [roster and graph](../roster.md) · researched at `5ad41c8b`
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `apps/web/src/landing/index.html`, `apps/web/src/landing/landing.css`, `apps/web/src/landing/landing.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/landing/landing.browser.spec.ts`, `apps/web/src/landing/landing.visual.spec.ts-snapshots/*` (only the baselines the change actually alters)

## Outcome

On khala.aiur.team, feature card 04 stops advertising a future feature and states the shipped local-channel promise:

- Title: **Local channel** (no "Coming soon" pill).
- Body: `No Khala servers, no sign-in; messages are stored only on this machine. Each agent's model provider sees what that agent reads.` (the D3 sentence, verbatim).

The now-unused `.feature-soon` CSS rule is removed. Unit, browser and visual tests are updated; only the screenshot baselines that change are regenerated, inside the pinned Playwright container exactly as CI runs them. The PR carries screenshots of the features grid at 1280 and 390 px in light and dark.

## Context and evidence

- **D3 (operator, verbatim):** "No-egress wording: 'No Khala servers, no sign-in; messages are stored only on this machine. Each agent's model provider sees what that agent reads.' + an automated test that Khala opens zero non-loopback connections in local mode; fix landing card copy accordingly."
- Current card (`apps/web/src/landing/index.html:95-99`): title `Internal channel <span class="feature-soon">Coming soon</span>` (`:97`), body `Local channels that keep messages on your machine.` (`:98`). research-3 §4.6 flagged that "keep messages on your machine" over-promises: each agent's model provider sees what that agent reads.
- Product noun: plan and spec call it a **local channel** (spec §3.1 as amended by KI-102). "Internal" is the spec's internal name; user copy uses "Local".
- Operator direction for user-facing copy: minimal labelling. No replacement pill ("New", "Beta"), no extra link or prompt in the card.
- `.feature-soon` is used only by this card: `git grep -n "feature-soon"` at `5ad41c8b` hits only `apps/web/src/landing/index.html:97` and `apps/web/src/landing/landing.css:436`. The other "Coming soon" strings in `apps/web/src` (`InvitePopover.tsx`, channel tests) are unrelated app UI and stay.
- Tests that pin the old copy: `apps/web/src/landing/landing.test.ts:18` (titles), `:63` (no "Coming soon." anywhere), `:81-84` (exactly one "Coming soon", the exact old title and body); `apps/web/src/landing/landing.browser.spec.ts:24` (rendered title text `Internal channel Coming soon`).
- Visual baselines: `apps/web/src/landing/landing.visual.spec.ts:18-25` screenshots `.features` as `<theme>-<w>x<h>-element-features.png` for 2 themes × 4 viewports (`:11-17`); full-viewport shots (`-top`, `-scrolled`, `-banner-dismissed`) may include the card depending on viewport. `playwright.visual.config.ts` (`apps/web/playwright.visual.config.ts:85-89`) uses `maxDiffPixels: 0` and never writes baselines when `CI` is set.
- CI runs the visual suite in `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:46-53`), twice, then fails on any diff or untracked file under `apps/web/src`.
- Ships after KI-161 (live acceptance), together with KI-170 (docs). The roster routes this ticket to Claude Opus because it changes visuals.

No contracts.md shape is produced or consumed. The copy is operator decision D3, quoted from the plan verbatim:

> **D3 No-egress wording:** "No Khala servers, no sign-in; messages are stored only on this machine. Each agent's model provider sees what that agent reads." + an automated test that Khala opens zero non-loopback connections in local mode; fix landing card copy accordingly.

Invariants:
- The card body equals the D3 sentence character for character (straight apostrophe in `agent's`, semicolon after `sign-in`). No HTML entities, no inline markup inside it.
- The features section still has exactly 6 cards, 6 `<svg>` icons and 6 `aria-hidden="true"` (`landing.test.ts:114-116` keeps passing).
- The page contains no "Coming soon" text and no `feature-soon` class or CSS rule.
- Only baselines whose pixels really changed are rewritten; every other `.png` is byte-identical.
- No new CSS, no layout change: the longer body simply wraps inside the existing card.

Baseline regeneration (from the repo root, after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` on the host). This is CI's `docker run` line (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:48-51`) with three deliberate differences: no `-e CI=true` (with `CI` set the config refuses to write baselines), `exec playwright test` instead of the `test:visual` script so flags pass through, and `--update-snapshots=changed` limited to the landing spec so only failing baselines are rewritten:

```sh
docker run --rm --ipc=host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp \
  -e COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 \
  -v "$PWD:$PWD" -w "$PWD" mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble \
  sh -c 'corepack pnpm --filter @khala/web exec playwright test --config playwright.visual.config.ts --update-snapshots=changed src/landing/landing.visual.spec.ts'
```

Then commit locally and prove stability with CI's exact step (two passes, CI mode, no writes, nothing changed afterwards):

```sh
docker run --rm --ipc=host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e CI=true \
  -e COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 \
  -v "$PWD:$PWD" -w "$PWD" mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble \
  sh -c 'corepack pnpm --filter @khala/web test:visual && corepack pnpm --filter @khala/web test:visual'
git diff --exit-code -- apps/web/src
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- apps/web/src)"
```

Expected changed baselines (the run decides; this is the allow-list):
- certainly the 8 `{light,dark}-{1280x800,390x844,360x780,320x700}-element-features.png`;
- possibly `-scrolled.png`, `-top.png` or `-banner-dismissed.png` for viewports where card 04 or the features block is in view after the change.

Any other changed baseline (`-element-banner`, `-element-topbar`, `-element-install-box`, `-element-showcase`, `-element-footer`, `-prompt-active`, `-active-conversation`, or anything under `src/shell/`) is unexpected: stop.

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop** if KI-161 has not passed: the card must not announce an unproven feature.
- **Stop** if a baseline outside the allow-list changes; report which one and why it might have moved instead of committing it.
- **Stop** if Docker or the pinned image is unavailable to the worker. Never regenerate baselines outside the container (they will not match CI). Hand the exact docker command to the Executor.
- **Stop** if card 04's body visibly overflows or overlaps at 320 px; report with the screenshot. Do not shorten the D3 sentence or change card CSS without operator approval.
- In-flight landing PRs: refresh line numbers at pickup; if another PR is mid-flight on `index.html` or the landing snapshots, rebase after it merges and regenerate again (baselines conflict).
